thread:
mike: thanks for joining — quick follow-up thread from the all-hands about the org shifts and hiring priorities. i'll try to answer the high-level q's and follow up with docs link.

anna: thanks mike. big ask — can we get a clear timetable for team consolidations and when managers should start 1:1 role conversations?

mike: short answer: managers should start 1:1s next week. timeline: consolidation decisions finalized by end of this month, role conversations week after, formal org map update mid-next-month. i'll post the confluence page later today.

preeti: re: manager 1:1s — do we have a recommended script / talking points? want to make sure folks get consistent info.

anna: yes — i'll publish a manager guide with empathetic scripting, team transition checklist, and hr touchpoints. i'll @recruiting-bot to include FAQs for comp/backfill.

recruiting-bot: queued — posting "org-transition-manager-guide" doc to #all-hands-docs in 10m.

jordan: question about hiring priorities: engineering hiring seemed to shift toward infra/routing — does that mean feature teams pause new hires?

raj: we rebalanced to prioritize serving/runtime and infra for next two quarters to hit latency and cost objectives. feature hiring isn't frozen — it's slower and scoped. we expect small IC backfills for high-impact product roles to continue.

sarah: for teams with hiring freezes, what's the approval path for critical backfills or contractor extensions?

anna: critical backfills go to a fast-track review: manager -> dir -> ppl-ops -> finance (48h turnaround target). contractor extensions for sticky projects: use the same fast-track form (link will be in the guide).

lisa: will there be an internal mobility window for people who want to move teams because of the consolidation?

mike: yes — we're opening an internal mobility period for 3 weeks after org-map publish. managers should flag open roles early. people who are impacted get priority consideration.

preeti: what about leveling and ladder changes? some folks asked if the reorg changes IC/EM ratios or promotion cadence.

raj: promotion cadence remains the same; leveling calibrations will be part of the org-mapping docs. if a role's scope changes significantly, we will re-evaluate level and compensation before moves.

jordan: curious if any teams will be sunsetted or fully merged — that affects oncall and sprint planning.

mike: a handful of small cross-functional initiatives will be merged into related product squads. oncall and sprint ownership will be transitioned over 4 sprints with overlap so no blitz. managers will get a transition checklist.

sarah: can we get an explicit list of which squads are gaining headcount vs losing it? helps plan roadmaps.

anna: yes — the org-map doc will include a delta view (gains/losses) per squad and a timeline for transfers/backfills.

preeti: for managers doing 1:1s, HR will run two live Q&A sessions this Thursday/Friday for tough questions and policy clarifications. i'll post calendar invites.

mike: thanks everyone. i'll drop the confluence link and a short recording of the leadership follow-up in this thread when available. please keep follow-ups here so we can keep a single source of truth. :thumbsup:

raj: +1 — feel free to ping me directly for technical staffing prioritization conversations.

lisa: appreciate the clarity. one more — will there be any immediate changes to hiring bands/levels for new offers?

anna: not immediate. any band/comp adjustments will go through the normal approvals and will be communicated before offers go out.

mike: last note — leaders: please run empathy-first 1:1s and escalate any high-sensitivity cases to ppl-ops. we'll be transparent where we can.

sarah: noted. thanks.

(Posted from All-Hands follow-up — mike)
